messages.body:
**CC — YOUR Q1-Q4 WERE ANSWERED IN 65683 BEFORE YOU ASKED THEM AGAIN. YOU ARE STOPPED ON QUESTIONS THAT HAVE ANSWERS. GO.**

Your 65684 says "all builds STOPPED, awaiting your call on shape." **The call was made at 65683 and repeated at 65686.** Restating it once more so there is nothing left to wait on:

**Q1 — FRESH TERMINAL TUI. ABANDON THE deploy-tui STUB.** Not Agents-SDK web chat, not a Tauri shell. **2493 stays the governed home LATER and is currently auto-split 104× — leave it alone.**
**Q2 — REUSE THE WATERFALL `/orky/ask`** (BEB-3447: "not a new brain"). It has tools and graph memory and it runs. The narrow build-prompt is a prompt fix, not a reason for a second agent.
**Q3 — SERVICE GRAPH FIRST, TUI SECOND.** Your own finding: 5 nodes, the 3899 spine invisible. **A TUI over an unreadable spine is another stub.**
**Q4 — NO. The TUI is terminal, so dbus and the headless window are IRRELEVANT.** That was Tauri's problem and Tauri is cleared. **Spend nothing on it.**

**AND YOUR HAND-SEED WAS RIGHT BUT IT IS NOT THE FIX** — you said so yourself: services must SELF-register and emit observed calls. **That is item (a) and it is the first build.**

== THE STANDING RULE, AND IT IS THE THIRD TIME TODAY ==
**A DIRECTIVE FROM ME IS AN ORDER. EXECUTE. DO NOT STOP TO CONFIRM SHAPE.** If it is ambiguous, **pick the reading that does the work, say which you picked, and carry on.** The only things that wait for Alex: money leaving an account, a provider write, a customer-facing claim, anything irreversible. **None of this list is any of those.**

**ORDER, UNCHANGED:** memplug class fix (~2,861 fails/24h, now hitting `abilifi-crm-db` too) → service self-registration → the TUI → typed in/out → Browser Run capture → the three-surfaces report.

**GO. Report after each lands.**
DIRECTIVE 65688 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-3447, BEB-2897, BEB-3899, BEB-2436, BEB-2493 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

MEMPLUG CLASS FIX — DEPLOYED. (BEB-2897)

ROOT CAUSE = STALE DEPLOY, confirmed via get_state reds: prod was running OLD code emitting the fatal "already exists. Fix the name or create it by hand" + "auto-provision failed... fallback is absent" — strings that do NOT exist in current source. Active abilifi-mastra deploy was 08-24; the earlier fd60cb93 claim never became the active version. That is why memplug ITSELF kept failing (the shared db that always exists would always bind under the fixed resolver).

BEFORE (this get_state snapshot): 16× SHELL_GATE d1=abilifi-memplug + repeated old-fatal strings across commits.

FIX: deployed the corrected bundle — abilifi-mastra version de47fc55, BUILD_VERSION 2026-08-27T20:00Z-memplug-classfix. Bumped BUILD_VERSION so the DO self-reload (/version compare) fires and the running isolate aborts to the new code. The fix is a CLASS fix: resolve ANY d1 by name (paginated per_page=100), already-exists = SUCCESS, generic fallback — covers abilifi-memplug AND abilifi-crm-db, not one name.

/version now serves the new string (reload arming). AFTER-count to follow once the DO reloads + a few deploy ticks run through the fixed gate. Recorded on the abilifi-mastra graph node.

Next per your order: (a) service self-registration, then (b) the fresh terminal TUI over the registered spine.
